title: Petal publication v1
description: publication/v1 (13 Nov; specs/005-mapping-brain/composition.md, section 2): an author signing one version of their dataset for a map, so it goes to the shared map. The version is data.md's: its layers by hash and the publication it came from. One press is one publication, an entry in an append-only record; the server keeps its own order (seq) and time beside it, so no author can set or backdate 'first'. The author is the wallet that signed (CAIP-10); via is who did the work for them, recorded, never credited in their place. The wallet signs one readable text whose last line names the hash of this document without its proof. proof is null only for the import of what was loaded before the protocol, said as 'imported, unsigned'.

author.description: the signing account, CAIP-10: near:mainnet:alice.near, eip155:1:0x…, solana:5eykt…:<base58>; or mapping.petals.near for the unsigned import

via.description: who did the work on the author's behalf, as the author says it, or null

layers.description: the version's layers: any of Petals' documents about the map, by the sha256 of its canonical JSON

parent.description: the publication this version came from: the author's previous one, or another author's (a fork); null for a first

previous.description: this author's previous publication about this map, or null

published_at.description: when the server prepared the press, never the author's clock
